title: Turn mobile broadband (WWAN) on or off
summary: Enable or disable the WWAN (mobile broadband) radio switch. Use this to save battery or disconnect from cellular networks.

steps.explain: Turn the WWAN radio switch on or off. Replace <STATE> with 'on' to enable or 'off' to disable.
steps.expect: The command completes without error. Cellular connectivity changes immediately.

rollback.explain: To undo, set the WWAN radio switch back to its previous state.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_STATE
placeholders.description: The state WWAN was in before (on or off)

warnings: Turning WWAN off will disconnect you from any active cellular data connections.
